false_positives.input_description: Valid report with full 64-character hex hash preceded by 'SHA-256:'
false_positives.erroneous_reason: BLOQUEIO [validate-generated-report]: Relatório reprovado pela auditoria cética (1 violação(ões)): [Regra 01 / Hash Truncado] Hash SHA-256 inválido ou truncado detectado: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde' (exigido 64 hex completos).
false_positives.root_cause: Line 228 regex uses quantifier [0-9a-fA-F]{4,63} which eagerly matches exactly the first 63 hex digits of a 64-char hash; line 233 then evaluates len(candidate) != 64, falsely concluding the hash is truncated.
false_positives.suggested_fix: In validate_generated_report.py line 228, update regex to check word boundaries or inspect full_matches like audit_executive_report.py does: r'(?:sha-?256|previous_sha256|catalog_hash|hash)\s*["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?([0-9a-fA-F]{4,63}(?:\.\.\.)?|[0-9a-fA-F]+\.\.\.)(?!\w)["\']?'.
false_positives.resolution_notes: Implemented lookahead boundary (?![0-9a-fA-F]) preventing eager truncation match on genuine 64-char hex hashes; added separate ELLIPSIS_HASH_PATTERN for catching truncated hashes with dots; isolated fenced code blocks.

false_positives.root_cause: post_test_audit.py line 189 only inspects payload.get('output') or payload.get('result') or snake_case payload.get('tool_response'), failing to unpack camelCase payload.get('toolResponse') from standard Antigravity events.
false_positives.suggested_fix: Add 'toolResponse' to the checked dictionary keys in lines 150 and 189 of post_test_audit.py.
false_positives.resolution_notes: Unpacked both camelCase toolResponse and snake_case tool_response across payload and tool_input; implemented UNKNOWN summary detection and enforced block_pass_verdict on non-zero exit codes or unparsed test output.
